fullPassage: What is the Capabilities Approach (CA), and why would lawyers passionate about animal justice care about it? It is easy to say what it is not. The CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans or seek special privileges for those considered most "like us," as do some other popular theoretical approaches. The CA has concern for the finch and the pig as much as the whale and the elephant. And it argues that the human form of life is simply irrelevant when we think about what each type of animal needs and deserves. What is relevant is their own forms of life. Just as humans seek to be able to enjoy the characteristic goods of a human life, so a finch seeks a finch's life and the whale a whale's life. We should extend ourselves and learn, not lazily picture animals as lesser humans, seeking a life sort of like our own. According to the CA, each sentient creature should have the opportunity to flourish in its own way, according to its own form of life.

주어는 the CA(역량 접근법)이고, 3인칭 단수 현재의 부정이므로 does not + 동사원형 rank(서열화하다)를 씁니다.

목적어는 animals(동물들)이고, '~에 따라'는 전치사 by로 나타냅니다. '인간과의 유사성'은 likeness(유사성) + to humans(인간과의)로 연결합니다.

완성: the CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans
det.tip: does not + 동사원형(rank) / by + 기준(likeness) / likeness to + 대상(humans)

questions.wa: the CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans
accept: the CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans

questions.passage: What is the Capabilities Approach (CA), and __________? It is easy to say what it is not. The CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans or seek special privileges for those considered most "like us," as do some other popular theoretical approaches. The CA has concern for the finch and the pig as much as the whale and the elephant. And it argues that the human form of life is simply irrelevant when we think about what each type of animal needs and deserves. What is relevant is their own forms of life. Just as humans seek to be able to enjoy the characteristic goods of a human life, so a finch seeks a finch's life and the whale a whale's life. We should extend ourselves and learn, not lazily picture animals as lesser humans, seeking a life sort of like our own. According to the CA, each sentient creature should have the opportunity to flourish in its own way, according to its own form of life.
questions.stem:
다음 [보기]의 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하여 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸을 (영어로) 완성하시오. (정확히 10단어)
왜 동물 정의에 열정적인 변호사들이 그것에 관심을 갖겠는가
[보기: justice / about / care / why / lawyers / animal / would / it / passionate / about]

det.korean: '왜 동물 정의에 열정적인 변호사들이 그것에 관심을 갖겠는가' = why would lawyers passionate about animal justice care about it
det.analysis:
'왜 ~하겠는가'는 의문사 why + 조동사 would + 주어 순서의 의문문입니다.

주어는 lawyers(변호사들)이고, 그 뒤에 형용사구 passionate about animal justice(동물 정의에 열정적인)가 lawyers를 뒤에서 꾸밉니다. 동사는 care about(~에 관심을 갖다)이고 목적어는 it입니다.

완성: why would lawyers passionate about animal justice care about it
det.tip: why + would + 주어(lawyers) / 형용사구(passionate about ~)가 명사를 뒤에서 수식 / care about + 대상

det.korean: '중요한 것은 그들 자신의 삶의 형태이다' = what is relevant is their own forms of life
det.analysis:
'중요한 것'은 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절 what is relevant(중요한 것)로 쓰고, 이 절 전체가 문장의 주어가 됩니다.

주어인 명사절은 단수 취급하므로 두 번째 동사도 is를 쓰고, 보어는 their own(그들 자신의) + forms of life(삶의 형태들)로 연결합니다.
